keyFindings: Massive improvement from previous test: 177 live markets (was 2), full order lifecycle works including market orders with auto-matching
Complete trading workflow: limit orders, market orders, cancel, amend, propose_match, split/merge shares, claim
Real-time streaming: 4 WebSocket tools for orderbook, market changes, and wallet order monitoring
Agent guide (get_agent_guide) provides thorough documentation: units, data model, orderbook mechanics, workflows, pitfalls
Error handling is excellent: Zod validation with field-level detail, structured isError flag, clear messages
Sports markets have real liquidity with tight 1.5-2c spreads and $100-300 depth per side
Full buy+sell round-trip executed: bought 1 YES @ $0.41, sold @ $0.40 on Heat vs Raptors
No balance check tool - agent cannot verify available USDC/ALGO before trading
No search/filter tool - must retrieve all markets and filter client-side
No preview/simulate tool - must calculate costs from orderbook data manually
blockers: Missing balance query: Agent cannot check available USDC or ALGO before placing orders, risking underflow errors on-chain. Workaround: catch the error and reduce size, but this wastes ALGO on failed transaction fees.
No search/filter: With 177 markets, inability to search by keyword or filter by category forces full list retrieval every time. Manageable but inefficient at scale.
